verdict.rationale: Runloop documents running code and commands inside Devboxes, described as full-featured execution environments. It also offers streamed or retrieved execution logs, stateful named shells, and a PTY for REPLs. Custom environments can be built from Dockerfiles, which implies any language runtime can be installed, but the docs never explicitly name Python, JavaScript or other runtimes, and results come back as logs rather than rich outputs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of supported language runtimes (Python, JavaScript, others), rich or structured result types beyond command logs (e.g. charts, data objects), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can execute code in multiple language runtimes (Python, JavaScript, and more) and get rich results back
